Elena (People Ops): @channel quick update on travel + PTO processes — please read and RTFA :wave:
Elena (People Ops): TL;DR: new Travel Risk Escrow requirement for high-risk business travel, streamlined preapproval flow, and an optional flexible PTO procedure for multi-day trips. Full details & FAQ below.
Elena (People Ops): Why: we've had edge cases affecting safety, reimbursements, and project coverage. These changes keep people safe and make expense reconciliation faster.
Elena (People Ops): What changes now: 1) For trips to regions flagged in the Travel Advisory list, managers will submit a preapproval form and a refundable travel escrow hold ($100–$500 depending on region). 2) For any trip longer than 4 days, you can apply Flexible PTO (split your workdays + PTO days in the HR portal). 3) Receipts & per-diem rules clarified.
Elena (People Ops): Key links: [Travel Advisory list] https://redwood-internal/travel-advisory, [Preapproval form] https://redwood-internal/hr/preapproval, [Flexible PTO guide] https://redwood-internal/hr/flex-pto. HR Bot will post checklist below.
Marco: Appreciate the clarity. Quick Q — who pays the escrow initially? Employee or company card?
Elena (People Ops): Good question. Manager pays the escrow with a corporate card when submitting the preapproval. It’s refundable within 5 business days after trip completion once compliance & safety check passes.
Aisha: Is there a waiver for short notice customer escalations? e.g., same-day flights to a flagged region?
Elena (People Ops): Yes — managers can request an expedited waiver. Submit the form and check the "expedited" box; People Ops will triage within 24 hours. Waivers are exception-based and logged.
Sam: Per-diem changes? I travel a lot — want to know if amounts changed for EU/APAC.
Elena (People Ops): Per-diem bands unchanged. We clarified what counts as meals vs incidentals (see Flexible PTO guide). If you want a CSV of current per-diem rates I can share.
Priya: If someone is combining personal travel with business (extended stay), how does Flexible PTO apply?
Elena (People Ops): If personal days are tacked on, use Flexible PTO to split work and PTO. You must declare combined travel in the preapproval form so we can flag visa/insurance differences.
HR Bot: Checklist (automated): 1) Complete preapproval form 2) Manager approval 3) Corporate card escrow charged 4) Travel safety briefing (if region flagged) 5) Upload receipts within 10 days of return. Link: https://redwood-internal/hr/checklist
Aisha: Can this be retroactive for trips booked last week? I already have receipts.
Elena (People Ops): Not retroactive for escrow, but if you booked a trip that would now fall under the policy, submit the post-trip reconciliation form and tag People Ops — we will evaluate on a case-by-case basis.
Marco: Any impact to recruiting travel? Interviewers sometimes need quick flights.
Elena (People Ops): Recruiting trips under $300 or same-city interviews are exempt from escrow. Anything flagged regionally still needs preapproval. Recruiting ops will get a short email with the rules.
Priya: Requesting a template for manager approvals so we standardize notes — can you share?
Elena (People Ops): Will post a short approval template in #people-ops-resources in 30m.
Sam: thanks. can you also confirm expense code for escrow when it refunds?
Elena (People Ops): Expense code ESCROW_REFUND — finance will reconcile automatically. Put reimbursement notes in the expense report.
Aisha: :thumbsup: moving to update our team handbook now.
Elena (People Ops): Thanks all. If you have specific edge cases DM me or drop them here. We’ll run training for people managers next Wed 11am PT. RSVP via the calendar invite.
Elena (People Ops): End.
